# Shrawan Effects

> Shrawan Effects is a high-performance web publication, technology engineering consultancy, and AI-driven software platform founded by Shrawan Sharma. It specializes in cutting-edge fullstack engineering (Laravel 12, PHP 8.3+, React, Vue, TypeScript), AI automation workflows, autonomous agents, OpenSEO intelligence tooling, and developer tutorials.

## Core Mission & Architecture
- **Website**: https://shrawaneffects.com/
- **Focus**: High-scalability web systems, custom CMS & SaaS platforms, LLM agent integration, real-time analytics, and Core Web Vitals engineering.
- **Tech Stack**: Laravel 12, Bootstrap 5.3 Cyberpunk HUD, Livewire/Alpine, MySQL, Python AI agents, OpenSEO Suite, Google Cloud, Docker.

## Services Offered
- **Fullstack Web Development**: Enterprise Laravel & PHP backends, responsive high-speed frontends.
- **AI Automation & Agents**: Autonomous LLM agent workflows, RAG systems, API integrations, and prompt engineering.
- **OpenSEO Suite**: Comprehensive real-time domain analysis, keyword research, SERP simulation, and Google Search Console integration.
- **Technical SEO & Performance**: 90+ Core Web Vitals, rich JSON-LD knowledge graphs, accessibility compliance, and server-level caching.
